answer_1.quote: Knowledge-grounded dialogue generation , which utilizes external knowledge to enhance conversation backgrounds ... Our goal is to simultaneously improve the diversity of knowledge selection and generate diverse knowledge-aware responses.
answer_1.outputs: Generated dialogue responses conditioned on selected knowledge

answer_2.quote: We report accuracy (Acc) to evaluate the knowledge selection . Besides, we use the traditional indicators, i.e., perplexity (PPL), BLEU-4 , ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2 and Distinct-2 to evaluate the quality of response generation.

answer_4.quote: We also conduct human evaluation for our model. We randomly sampled 300 generated response and then we invite six annotators to select out their preferred response (win), or vote a tie, considering the following aspects: diversity, coherence and knowledge engagement.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to choose the preferred response or indicate a tie, evaluating each response on diversity, coherence, and knowledge engagement.
